benchmarks.title: Metformin & Mammalian Longevity
benchmarks.hypothesis: Chronic Metformin administration extends healthy lifespan in non-diabetic mammals via AMPK activation and caloric restriction mimetics.
benchmarks.summary: Metformin reliably extends lifespan in nematode (C. elegans) models by altering microbial folate metabolism, but landmark multi-center mammalian studies (e.g., NIA Interventions Testing Program) observed no significant lifespan extension in healthy normoglycemic male mice, revealing severe species- and metabolic-state dependency.
benchmarks.root_contradiction: Discrepancy is driven by: (1) indirect microbiome-mediated effects in invertebrates vs. direct hepatic metabolism in mammals; (2) baseline metabolic health—metformin protects against hyperinsulinemic and diabetic damage but provides no benefit or slight mitochondrial toxicity in metabolically optimal wild-type animals; and (3) dosing variations causing lactic acidosis.

papers.title: Metformin promotes lifespan through mitohormesis via the lysosomal pathway in C. elegans
papers.authors: Cabreiro, F., Au, C., Leung, K. Y., et al.
papers.claim: Metformin treatment significantly increases median lifespan (by ~20-30%) in C. elegans by perturbing bacterial folate and methionine metabolism.
papers.evidence_quote: Metformin-induced longevity is dependent on the co-cultured E. coli microbiome, altering microbial methionine and folate cycles to induce dietary restriction.

factors.model_system: C. elegans (monoxenic culture with E. coli OP50)
factors.confounders: Non-mammalian host; obligate dependence on bacterial metabolism

papers.title: Metformin improves healthspan and lifespan in male mice
papers.authors: Martin-Montalvo, A., Mercken, E. M., Mitchell, S. J., et al.
papers.claim: 0.1% w/w dietary metformin extended mean lifespan by 5.83% in male C57BL/6 mice and improved physical performance.
papers.evidence_quote: Treatment of male C57BL/6 mice with 0.1% metformin extended mean lifespan by 5.83% and increased insulin sensitivity while lowering LDL.

factors.model_system: Inbred male C57BL/6 mice (single sex, single strain)
factors.readout: Mean lifespan, rotorod performance, serum biomarkers
factors.confounders: Single-sex cohort; tested at a single institution; high-dose cohort (1%) suffered early toxic mortality

papers.title: Metformin failed to extend lifespan in genetically heterogeneous male and female mice: The NIA Interventions Testing Program
papers.authors: Strong, R., Miller, R. A., Antebi, A., et al.
papers.claim: Metformin across three independent testing sites did not significantly extend median or maximum lifespan in genetically diverse UM-HET3 mice.
papers.evidence_quote: Metformin tested at 0.1% in chow across three independent laboratories produced no statistically significant increase in lifespan in either male or female UM-HET3 mice.

factors.model_system: Genetically heterogeneous UM-HET3 mice (both sexes, 3 independent sites)
factors.intervention: 0.1% w/w metformin in diet started at 9 months of age
factors.readout: Statistical log-rank survival analysis across 3 replicated cohorts
factors.confounders: Dose was fixed rather than calibrated by circulating plasma levels

papers.title: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I and impairs exercise-induced adaptations in healthy older adults
papers.authors: Konopka, A. R., Murphy, P. M., Chandrasekaran, P., et al.
papers.claim: Metformin blunts the cardioprotective and mitochondrial respiratory gains achieved via aerobic exercise training in healthy normoglycemic seniors.
papers.evidence_quote: Metformin attenuated the exercise-mediated increase in whole-body insulin sensitivity and skeletal muscle mitochondrial respiration.

factors.intervention: Metformin 1000 mg/day vs placebo paired with 12 weeks aerobic training
factors.readout: Skeletal muscle biopsy mitochondrial respiration, VO2 max
factors.confounders: Short 12-week intervention; focused on functional capacity rather than decades-long mortality

papers.title: Metformin as a tool to target aging: The TAME (Targeting Aging with Metformin) framework
papers.authors: Barzilai, N., Crandall, J. P., Kritchevsky, S. B., Espeland, M. A.
papers.claim: Metformin's apparent healthspan benefits in humans are largely observed in pre-diabetic or metabolically challenged individuals, modulating age-related multimorbidity rather than basal biological aging in healthy individuals.
papers.evidence_quote: The epidemiological evidence in humans primarily reflects reduction of secondary chronic disease incidence in populations with pre-existing metabolic dysfunction.

factors.model_system: Retrospective human clinical cohort analysis and proposed trial design
factors.readout: Time-to-first major age-related chronic disease (CVD, cancer, dementia)
factors.confounders: Observational confounding by indication in historical cohorts

tie_breaker_experiment.title: Factorial Stratification of Metformin Longevity: Baseline Glycemic Load vs. Titrated Pharmacokinetic Exposure in Heterogeneous Mammals
tie_breaker_experiment.rationale: Resolves whether metformin longevity requires pre-existing metabolic friction (high glycemic/adipose stress) or if sub-toxic, PK-calibrated doses benefit normoglycemic mammals without blunting mitochondrial capacity.
tie_breaker_experiment.design_type: 2 x 2 Factorial Multi-Cohort In Vivo Trial
independent_variables: Metabolic Baseline: Normoglycemic Standard Diet vs. Mild Diet-Induced Insulin Resistance (Low-dose HFD)
Metformin Regimen: Vehicle vs. Pharmacokinetically-titrated continuous plasma level (targeting 1.5 µM steady-state) vs. Intermittent pulsed dosing
dependent_variables: Primary: Median and 90th percentile survival (Kaplan-Meier, log-rank)
Secondary: High-resolution skeletal muscle respirometry (Oxygraph-2k), continuous glucose telemetry, and lactate accumulation
controls: Positive: Caloric restriction (15% CR) positive longevity benchmark
Negative: Vehicle-treated age-matched littermates in identical ambient temperature (22°C vs 28°C thermoneutrality)
protocol_steps: Cohort Assembly: 600 UM-HET3 mice (300M/300F) randomized at 8 months across 6 experimental arms.
Baseline Phenotyping: IPGTT (intraperitoneal glucose tolerance), echocardiography, and whole-body metabolic cage calorimetry.
Dosing Administration: Micro-encapsulated metformin administered via automated dietary feeding system calibrated to weekly mass.
Longitudinal Biomarker Sampling: Bimonthly blood draws for plasma metformin (LC-MS/MS), lactate, beta-hydroxybutyrate, and GDF15.
Mitochondrial Respirometry: Sub-cohort sacrificial biopsies at 18 months evaluating Complex I-IV activity in soleus and gastrocnemius muscle.
Survival Censoring: Double-blind daily health monitoring with standardized criteria for moribund euthanasia.

decisive_outcomes.condition: If Metformin extends lifespan ONLY in the mild insulin-resistant cohort while producing neutral or negative lifespan curves in normoglycemic mice
decisive_outcomes.verdict: Validates the Metabolic Friction Boundary: Metformin is a pathology-dependent disease mitigator rather than a universal pro-longevity geroprotector.

decisive_outcomes.condition: If Metformin extends lifespan in BOTH cohorts when dosed to maintain plasma levels between 1.0-2.0 µM without lactate spikes
decisive_outcomes.verdict: Validates the Direct Geroprotective Hypothesis: Previous NIA ITP failures were artifacts of fixed dietary dosing causing sub-therapeutic or toxic extremes.

tie_breaker_experiment.statistical_power: n=100 per arm provides 92% power to detect an 8% difference in median survival at alpha = 0.01.

benchmarks.title: Chain-of-Thought: Algorithmic Reasoning vs. Token Budget
benchmarks.hypothesis: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting elicits intrinsic, multi-step algorithmic reasoning in transformers rather than acting as an expanded autoregressive token-budget computation.
benchmarks.summary: While early papers attributed CoT performance to emergent mathematical reasoning capabilities, recent counterfactual benchmark tests (GSM-Symbolic, Apple Research 2024) demonstrate that changing problem characters or adding irrelevant clauses causes drastic accuracy collapse, suggesting shallow template pattern completion rather than invariant logical deduction.
benchmarks.root_contradiction: The contradiction stems from benchmark contamination and lexical shortcut exploitation: standard benchmarks (GSM8k, MATH) share formulaic syntax with pretraining corpora, conflating token-space autoregressive search depth with true symbolic invariant reasoning.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Wei, J., Wang, X., Schuurmans, D., et al.
papers.claim: Generating a sequence of intermediate reasoning steps significantly improves arithmetic, commonsense, and symbolic reasoning performance across state-of-the-art models.
papers.evidence_quote: CoT prompting leads to emergent reasoning capabilities: on GSM8K, PaLM 540B with CoT improves accuracy from 17.9% to 56.9%.

factors.readout: Exact match accuracy on GSM8K, SVAMP, ASDiv
factors.confounders: Static benchmarks present in training distributions

papers.title: GSM-Symbolic: Understanding the Limitations of Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Mirzadeh, I., Alizadeh, K., Shahrokhi, H., et al. (Apple)
papers.claim: LLM performance with CoT exhibits substantial variance and drops precipitously (up to 65%) when symbolic names and numbers are altered, failing basic formal reasoning.
papers.evidence_quote: We demonstrate that current LLMs rely heavily on surface-level pattern matching; altering surface tokens without changing logical structure causes dramatic performance degradation.

factors.intervention: Symbolic template synthesis with counterfactual clause injection
factors.readout: Performance variance distribution across 100 template permutations

papers.title: Let's Think Dot by Dot: Hidden Computation in Token-Budget Autoregression
papers.authors: Pfau, J., Merrill, W., Bowman, S. R.
papers.claim: CoT works primarily by providing additional recurrent forward-pass layers (parallel computation steps) rather than semantic cognitive deliberation; meaningless filler tokens ('...') provide comparable boosts.
papers.evidence_quote: Filling the intermediate CoT sequence with meaningless repetitive tokens produces significant gains, proving that serial compute budget rather than semantic steps drives success.

factors.model_system: Transformer models on 3-SAT and Graph Reachability
factors.readout: Complexity class tractability and circuit depth equivalence
factors.confounders: Synthetic task domain vs natural language dialogue

rows: Up to 65% drop upon trivial perturbation
Filler tokens replicate 80% of CoT boost

tie_breaker_experiment.title: Decoupling Semantic Planning from Forward-Pass Token Depth via Isomorphic Non-Natural Grammars
tie_breaker_experiment.rationale: Directly isolates whether CoT's advantage arises from human semantic guidance (true planning) or simply from granting $O(N)$ transformer feedforward depth through token output length.
independent_variables: Token Semantic Content: Natural Language CoT vs. Cipher-Encrypted CoT (preserving dependency DAG) vs. Uniform Blank Tokens
Structural Invariance: Isomorphic DAG transformation with novel, un-crawled logic structures
dependent_variables: Attention Matrix Entropy & Circuit Activation Consistency
protocol_steps: Generate 1,000 synthetic logic problems mapped onto directed acyclic computation graphs with verified zero web presence.
Test models across 4 conditions: Direct answer, Natural CoT, Inverted/Ciphered CoT, and Filler Dots.
Enforce exact token-length matching across conditions to eliminate compute budget disparity.
Compute robustness index: Ratio of variance across semantic permutations.

decisive_outcomes.condition: If Ciphered CoT and Filler Dots perform identically to Natural CoT at identical token length
decisive_outcomes.verdict: Refutes Algorithmic Planning: CoT is strictly a token-space compute allocation mechanism.

decisive_outcomes.condition: If Natural CoT maintains a statistically significant performance delta (>25%) over length-matched Filler Dots and Ciphered tokens
decisive_outcomes.verdict: Validates Semantic Reasoning: Natural language intermediate tokens provide true inductive guidance for transformer circuit routing.

tie_breaker_experiment.statistical_power: 1,000 instances x 10 seeds yields >99% confidence interval separation.

benchmarks.title: Adult Human Hippocampal Neurogenesis
benchmarks.hypothesis: Substantial neurogenesis continues throughout adult human life in the subgranular zone of the dentate gyrus.
benchmarks.summary: Studies using post-mortem human brain samples disagree sharply on whether new neurons are generated in adult humans. Sorrells et al. (Nature 2018) found neurogenesis drops to undetectable levels by adulthood, whereas Boldrini et al. (Cell Stem Cell 2018) and Moreno-Jiménez et al. (Nature Medicine 2019) detected thousands of immature DCX+ neurons even in octogenarians.
benchmarks.root_contradiction: Differences in tissue fixation time (post-mortem delay), antigen retrieval chemistry, and cross-reactivity of commercial Doublecortin (DCX) antibodies against glial or vascular structures.

papers.title: Human hippocampal neurogenesis drops sharply in children to undetectable levels in adults
papers.authors: Sorrells, S. F., Paredes, M. F., Cebrian-Silla, A., et al.
papers.claim: Young neurons are abundant in the human hippocampus during gestation and early infancy, but decrease precipitously and are extremely rare or absent in adults.
papers.evidence_quote: We found that the number of proliferating progenitors and immature neurons in the dentate gyrus drops sharply during the first year of life and is undetectable in adults.

factors.model_system: 59 human post-mortem and post-operative brain samples
factors.intervention: Immunohistochemical staining for DCX, PSA-NCAM, NeuN, SOX2
factors.readout: Stereological cell counts per dentate gyrus volume
factors.confounders: Variable post-mortem delay (up to 48 hours) causing epitope degradation

papers.title: Human Hippocampal Neurogenesis Persists throughout Aging in Healthy Subjects
papers.authors: Boldrini, M., Fulmore, C. A., Tartt, A. N., et al.
papers.claim: Healthy older men and women have similar numbers of intermediate neural progenitors and thousands of immature DCX+ neurons in the dentate gyrus as younger individuals.
papers.evidence_quote: We found comparable numbers of human neural progenitors and immature neurons in the dentate gyrus across individuals aged 14 to 79 years.

factors.model_system: 28 fresh-frozen whole human hippocampi from sudden-death healthy individuals
factors.intervention: Stereology with strict post-mortem interval (<26h) and immediate 4% PFA fixation
factors.readout: Unbiased stereological quantification of Ki-67+ and DCX+ cells
factors.confounders: Reliance on antibody staining without single-cell transcriptomic verification

rows: Thousands of immature neurons persistent to age 79
Persistent neurogenesis markedly impaired in Alzheimer's

tie_breaker_experiment.title: Multi-Modal Spatial Transcriptomics and High-Depth snRNA-Seq on Rapid-Autopsy Human Dentate Gyrus (<2h PMI)
tie_breaker_experiment.rationale: Resolves the antibody artifact debate by profiling individual cell transcriptomes and chromatin accessibility without depending solely on DCX antibody staining.
tie_breaker_experiment.design_type: Multi-Center Prospective Rapid-Autopsy Single-Nucleus Multiome (RNA + ATAC) Study
independent_variables: Age Brackets: 20-35 yrs, 45-60 yrs, 70-85 yrs (n=15 per group, balanced sexes)
Tissue Handling: Ultra-rapid organ-donor autopsy (<2 hr PMI) with standardized flash-cryopreservation
dependent_variables: Single-nucleus co-expression of granule cell lineage trajectory: (SOX2/PAX6) -> (NEUROD1/DCX) -> (PROX1/CALB1)
Spatial in situ hybridization (MERFISH/Xenium) mapping exact subgranular zone coordinates
controls: Positive control: Adult rodent and non-human primate (Macaca mulatta) dentate gyrus processed with identical chemistry
Negative control: Adjacent human cerebral cortex layers devoid of adult neurogenic niches
protocol_steps: Tissue Sourcing: Protocol established across 3 transplant-donor surgical centers with <120 minute warm ischemia time.
Nuclei Isolation: Dounce homogenization under RNase-free conditions with FACS sorting for NeuN+ and NeuN- populations.
10x Multiome Assay: Simultaneous single-cell ATAC and 3' Gene Expression profiling at >50,000 reads/nucleus.
Computational Trajectory Inference: Pseudotime analysis (Monocle 3 and scVelo) testing whether an unbroken progenitor-to-neuron differentiation arc exists.

decisive_outcomes.condition: If an unbroken transcriptional pseudotime lineage is identified with continuous PROX1+ and NEUROD1+ progenitor clusters in aged brains
decisive_outcomes.verdict: Conclusively verifies adult human neurogenesis; previous negative findings were fixation-induced antigen loss.

decisive_outcomes.condition: If single-cell clustering shows mature granule cells and glial cells but completely discontinuous transcriptomic gaps with zero active neuroblasts
decisive_outcomes.verdict: Conclusively rejects persistent adult neurogenesis; proves positive DCX stainings were non-specific ectopic antibody binding.

tie_breaker_experiment.statistical_power: 45 donors x 10,000 nuclei/sample gives >99% sensitivity to detect cell populations present at >0.05% frequency.
